terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.sec1Desc: The Da Nang Digital Marina Management System (DDMS) provides an online platform connecting travelers with licensed boat and yacht operators in Da Nang City. By accessing or using any services on DDMS, you agree to comply with all terms and conditions stated herein.
terms.sec2Item1: All payment transactions on DDMS are securely processed via the PayOS interbank gateway (supporting VietQR transfer, local Napas cards, and international Visa/MasterCard).
terms.sec2Item2: Upon successful payment, the system automatically issues an E-Ticket QR Code and sends a booking confirmation to your registered email.
terms.sec2Item3: Listed tour prices include mandatory marine passenger insurance pursuant to Vietnam Inland Waterways regulations.
terms.sec3Desc: All passengers and boat operators must strictly adhere to maritime safety guidelines while navigating the Han River and Da Nang Bay:
terms.sec3Item1: Passengers must wear life jackets during departure and transit as instructed by the captain.
terms.sec3Item2: Flammable items, explosives, weapons, or illegal substances are strictly prohibited on board.
terms.sec3Item3: Passengers should arrive at the departure port at least 15 minutes prior to scheduled departure for check-in.
terms.sec4Desc: Operators must ensure all vessels hold valid registration, technical inspection certificates, qualified captain licenses, and safety gear. DDMS reserves the right to suspend any partner violating port safety regulations.
terms.sec5Desc: In the event of severe weather (storms, strong wind gusts) or official port departure bans issued by Da Nang Maritime Authorities, trips will be rescheduled or fully refunded (100%) according to our Cancellation Policy.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.sec1Desc: When you create an account, book a cruise, or apply as a boat owner partner on DDMS, we collect necessary data to operate maritime services safely:
privacy.sec1Item1: Personal details: Full name, email address, phone number, avatar.
privacy.sec1Item2: Passenger manifest information: Companion details, Citizen ID/Passport numbers (required for maritime travel insurance).
privacy.sec1Item3: Boat partner documentation: Vessel inspection certificates, waterway transport licenses, captain credentials.
privacy.sec2Item1: To generate electronic tickets and enable automated Kiosk check-in at the Han River cruise port.
privacy.sec2Item2: To send trip notifications, departure reminders, and severe weather advisories.
privacy.sec2Item3: To provide passenger manifests to Maritime Authorities and Insurance Providers upon legal request.
privacy.sec3Desc: We employ 256-bit SSL/TLS encryption for all data transmissions. Payment card details are never stored on DDMS servers and are securely handled by PCI-DSS certified PayOS payment gateways.
privacy.sec4Desc: You retain the right to access and update your profile information anytime, or request complete account and data deletion by contacting our customer support team.

cancellation.title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
cancellation.highlightDesc: DDMS is committed to protecting traveler rights with a 100% money-back guarantee in cases of severe weather or cancellations made within the eligible timeframe.
cancellation.time2Desc: Covers reservation holding and prep costs
cancellation.time3: Cancelled < 12 hours before departure or No-Show
cancellation.time3Desc: Vessel manifest finalized and departure confirmed
cancellation.sec2Title: 2. Weather Cancellations & Force Majeure (Port Authority Bans)
cancellation.sec2Desc: Passenger safety is our highest priority. In the event of heavy rain, typhoons, or official harbor departure bans from Da Nang Port Authority:
cancellation.sec2Item1: Travelers can reschedule to any future date with open capacity free of charge.
cancellation.sec2Item2: If rescheduling is not possible, a 100% automated refund will be processed within 24 - 48 business hours.
cancellation.sec3Desc: Refunded amounts will be credited directly back to the original payment method:
cancellation.sec3Item1: VietQR / Domestic Bank Transfer: Refund completed within 1 - 2 business days.
cancellation.sec3Item2: International Visa / MasterCard: Refund completed within 5 - 7 business days depending on the card-issuing bank.
